verdict.rationale: v0's docs describe it as an AI agent that builds full-stack apps from chat prompts. It scaffolds full-stack apps, plans and connects to databases as it builds, integrates backends like Supabase and Neon, and deploys in one click; the SDK shows a plain-language prompt like 'Build me a personal website'. A community report independently confirms a working internal app with auth, roles and export reaching users quickly. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how backend and database logic is generated (the evidence is mostly short marketing claims), and more than one independent hands-on report of complete full-stack results.
